omitted_gates.reason: flat-list concept: it reads the single consistent aria-setsize the rows advertise, else 0. The store path paints a tree, whose rows advertise per-sibling-group setsize, so it collapses to 0 and reports UNKNOWN on every run. hier-cli's a11y_tree_structure is the gate that can fail on a tree; it is not reusable here because it reads the page's tree.pre_mutation_rows block, which only a HierSinkPayload carries, and it arrives bundled with tree_shape_match and the two mutation gates this rig cannot feed.
